import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

EPSILON = 0.01


def compute_rmse(y_true, y_pred):
    return np.sqrt(np.mean((y_true - y_pred) ** 2))


def main():
    train_path = "./input/labels.csv"
    test_path = "./input/test.csv"
    submission_path = "./submission/submission.csv"

    os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

    print("Loading data...")
    train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
    test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)

    print("Filtering training data with invalid coordinates...")
    NYC_LONG_MIN, NYC_LONG_MAX = -80, -70
    NYC_LAT_MIN, NYC_LAT_MAX = 38, 45

    lat_ok = (
        (train_df["pickup_latitude"] >= NYC_LAT_MIN)
        & (train_df["pickup_latitude"] <= NYC_LAT_MAX)
        & (train_df["dropoff_latitude"] >= NYC_LAT_MIN)
        & (train_df["dropoff_latitude"] <= NYC_LAT_MAX)
    )
    long_ok = (
        (train_df["pickup_longitude"] >= NYC_LONG_MIN)
        & (train_df["pickup_longitude"] <= NYC_LONG_MAX)
        & (train_df["dropoff_longitude"] >= NYC_LONG_MIN)
        & (train_df["dropoff_longitude"] <= NYC_LONG_MAX)
    )
    train_df = train_df[(lat_ok & long_ok)].reset_index(drop=True)

    print(
        f"Filtered from {len(train_df['fare_amount'].values)} to {len(train_df)} valid rows"
    )

    print("Engineering features...")
    features = [
        "pickup_longitude",
        "pickup_latitude",
        "dropoff_longitude",
        "dropoff_latitude",
        "passenger_count",
    ]

    test_df = test_df.copy()

    train_df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(train_df["pickup_datetime"])
    test_df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(test_df["pickup_datetime"])

    train_df["hour"] = train_df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    train_df["dayofweek"] = train_df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
    test_df["hour"] = test_df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    test_df["dayofweek"] = test_df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek

    train_df["month"] = train_df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month
    train_df["is_weekend"] = (train_df["dayofweek"] >= 5).astype(int)
    test_df["month"] = test_df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month
    test_df["is_weekend"] = (test_df["dayofweek"] >= 5).astype(int)

    rush_hours = [7, 8, 9, 17, 18, 19]
    train_df["is_rush_hour"] = train_df["hour"].isin(rush_hours).astype(int)
    test_df["is_rush_hour"] = test_df["hour"].isin(rush_hours).astype(int)

    # Manhattan Distance
    train_df["dist"] = np.abs(
        train_df["dropoff_latitude"] - train_df["pickup_latitude"]
    ) + np.abs(train_df["dropoff_longitude"] - train_df["pickup_longitude"])
    test_df["dist"] = np.abs(
        test_df["dropoff_latitude"] - test_df["pickup_latitude"]
    ) + np.abs(test_df["dropoff_longitude"] - test_df["pickup_longitude"])

    # New Feature: Log Distance
    # Adding log distance helps capture non-linearity of short trips (base fare) vs long trips (distance)
    train_df["log_dist"] = np.log(train_df["dist"] + 1e-6)
    test_df["log_dist"] = np.log(test_df["dist"] + 1e-6)

    train_df["dist_rush"] = train_df["dist"] * train_df["is_rush_hour"]
    test_df["dist_rush"] = test_df["dist"] * test_df["is_rush_hour"]

    feature_cols = features + [
        "hour",
        "dayofweek",
        "month",
        "is_weekend",
        "dist",
        "is_rush_hour",
        "dist_rush",
        "log_dist",
    ]

    print("Sampling training data...")
    n_samples = 4_000_000
    sampled_df = train_df.sample(
        n=min(n_samples, len(train_df)), random_state=42
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    print("Preparing log-transformed target with preserved original values...")
    fare_original = sampled_df["fare_amount"].copy()
    fare_target = sampled_df["fare_amount"].copy()

    fare_cleaned = fare_target.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(EPSILON)
    fare_cleaned = fare_cleaned.clip(lower=EPSILON)
    sampled_df["log_fare"] = np.log(fare_cleaned)

    sampled_df = sampled_df[feature_cols + ["log_fare"]]
    sampled_df.rename(columns={"log_fare": "target"}, inplace=True)

    train_sample = sampled_df.drop(columns=["target"])
    target_sample = sampled_df["target"]
    original_target = fare_original

    val_idx = int(len(train_sample) * 0.8)
    X_train, X_val = train_sample[:val_idx], train_sample[val_idx:]
    y_train, y_val = target_sample[:val_idx], target_sample[val_idx:]
    y_val_orig = original_target.iloc[val_idx:]

    print(f"Training on {len(X_train)} rows...")

    model = lgb.LGBMRegressor(
        n_estimators=200,
        num_leaves=63,
        learning_rate=0.03,
        max_depth=8,
        random_state=42,
        verbose=-1,
    )
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)

    val_pred_log = model.predict(X_val)
    val_pred = np.exp(val_pred_log)

    val_rmse = compute_rmse(y_val_orig, val_pred)
    print(f"Validation RMSE: {val_rmse:.4f}")

    print("Preparing test predictions...")
    test_features = test_df[feature_cols]
    test_predictions_log = model.predict(test_features)
    test_predictions = np.exp(test_predictions_log)

    print("Saving submission...")
    submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
        {"key": test_df["key"], "fare_amount": test_predictions}
    )
    submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)

    print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path}")
    print(f"Final Validation RMSE: {val_rmse:.4f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
plan: I will introduce a logarithmic distance feature by computing `np.log(manhattan_distance + 1)` to better model the non-linear contribution of trip length on fare amounts, especially for short trips where the base fare dominates. This transformation allows the LightGBM model to learn the pricing curve more flexibly without altering the existing coordinate filtering or hyperparameters. The new feature will be integrated into the training pipeline alongside the previous linear distance feature to provide complementary signals for the validation and test splits.
